why: Sources confirm global regularity for the classical Vlasov-Maxwell system with large data remains explicitly open as of 2025-2026; a 2025 paper (Constantin & Grayer, arXiv:2504.01687) proves global regularity for a distinct 'Radiative Vlasov-Maxwell' model, not the classical system this bullet refers to.

found.note: Proves global regularity for large data, but for a modified 'radiative' Vlasov-Maxwell system with additional radiation damping forces, not the classical system.
